text.ask:
🔴 **Undated pages falsely complete backfills**

When every block lacks a readable date, `post(from:)` drops the entire page. [WebPreviewSource.crawl](https://github.com/laconicman/telegram-kb/blob/c737ba898816417f882f25484964aa94d4dd258d/Sources/TelegramKBIngest/WebPreviewSource.swift#L131 "Sources/TelegramKBIngest/WebPreviewSource.swift:131") treats empty posts as exhaustion, marking the unfinished backfill complete.

Learn more



An unreadable block is counted by `WebPreviewParser.page`, but a page containing only unreadable blocks has no parsed posts. [WebPreviewSource.crawl](https://github.com/laconicman/telegram-kb/blob/c737ba898816417f882f25484964aa94d4dd258d/Sources/TelegramKBIngest/WebPreviewSource.swift#L121-L134 "Sources/TelegramKBIngest/WebPreviewSource.swift:121-134") checks only parsed posts to decide whether history ended. It then passes `reachedEnd` to [ChannelSync.sync](https://github.com/laconicman/telegram-kb/blob/c737ba898816417f882f25484964aa94d4dd258d/Sources/TelegramKBSync/ChannelSync.swift#L82-L88 "Sources/TelegramKBSync/ChannelSync.swift:82-88"), which records the backfill as complete. Subsequent syncs use that completion state instead of resuming the skipped history.

**Example:** A fresh channel yields a valid first page and then a page of 20 blocks without readable dates. The second page contributes zero posts, so the crawler marks the backfill complete instead of reporting an unreadable page and leaving the backfill open.

**Recommended fix:** In `WebPreviewSource.crawl`, distinguish zero message blocks from zero readable posts using the parser's block count or `skippedBlocks`. Do not set `reachedEnd` when unreadable blocks exist; keep the backfill resumable and surface the warning. Add a crawler test covering an all-undated page after a valid page.





*Was this helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to provide feedback.*
text.reply: Fixed in e7099c2: the exhaustion guard now requires zero *message blocks*, not zero parsed posts — an all-unreadable page stops the walk without claiming the end, so the backfill stays resumable and the skips surface in `unreadableBlocks`. Regression test `allUnreadablePageIsNotExhaustion` plus a mutant restoring the unconditional `reachedEnd = true`, red-verified.
